0.q: What do I get for free?
0.a: Everything except API Access. Without an account you can read every library record and use the map. A free account (Explorer) adds context layers, comparisons, change history, saved views and exports of up to {exportRows} rows. Your first accepted contribution makes you a Contributor, with {reachPerWeek} Reach calculations a week.

1.a: Each accepted, substantive contribution counts once: new libraries, corrections, photos, translations, articles and similar. Daily streaks, bonuses and administrative adjustments don’t count. Your profile shows your count and your progress to {supporterAt}. Supporter adds no tools or authority.

2.a: {apiPrice} a month, tax included, for {apiRequests} requests, {apiMib} MiB of response data and {apiCredits} analysis credits in each billing period. Overage is off unless you switch it on; then it costs {requestPrice} per extra request, {mibPrice} per extra MiB and {creditPrice} per extra analysis credit, up to a monthly cap of {capMin} to {capMax}.

3.q: Do I need an organisation to buy API Access?
3.a: No. If you buy for yourself we set up a free organisation with you as its only Organiser, so you can add colleagues later. Organisers manage keys and billing; members can see usage.

4.q: Does paying or sponsoring give me editing rights?
4.a: No. Editing a library record needs verified staff authority for that library, which we check with the library. API Access, sponsorship, recognition and organisation membership never grant it.

5.a: Sponsorship funds a programme of work, such as data quality or translation, with quarterly activity updates and an annual impact report. We agree the amount with each sponsor: email {contactEmail} or use the contact form. It is not a charitable donation and doesn’t include API Access.

6.a: Yes, at any time from billing management on the Developers page. Access continues until the end of the paid period. See the cancellation and refund policy for your statutory rights.
